nodes.text: @InformedNJNurse Metapneumovirus circulates every year along with flu, RSV, and coronaviruses (and COVID since 2020 obviously). Coronaviruses are colds. The rest are respiratory viruses. It’s the reason winter is called “cold and flu season”. None of this is new.
